notes.title: An update from the Xenon Racer Team!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/4cefab5c0107852e840b675eb4aecb03b0de209a.jpg

Xenon Racer continues its unstoppable run on Steam and as so many new pilots have pulled on a helmet to join the race we wanted to thank you all personally.

Before wishing you happy holidays, wherever you may be, we want to share with you a concept of an unprecedented futuristic team. The material was designed as part of a university thesis at the IAAD institute in Turin, Italy and we love the final result. Congratulating "Francesco Randazzo", we hope everyone can release their creative ideas and hurtle down any road that separates from their dreams!

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/731b5254334e84273b6faa58892d6edebcae3125.jpg

"At the end of the IAAD training course, students are given mentors from within the industry to polish the final version of their thesis, in order to ensure that their projects are also valid from a real world point of view.

I had the good fortune in this final part of the training course to have as my mentor Francesco Bruschi, CEO of 3DClouds, who helped me define and polish my designs and helped me understand the designer-client relationship dynamics.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/5a57b1dde17eef721750af944ef8965ee43eb346.jpg

Working on the "Andromeda" concept was really exciting for me. I considered the project assigned to me as an experiment to test the skills acquired during my studies, and also an area for personal growth.

The contribution and constant support of my thesis supervisor, Professor Matteo Doro, was very important but also fundamental introducing me to the world of "3D art" which is what I hope will become my future working career.

To conclude, I believe that for any designer there is nothing more gratifying than seeing their ideas realized."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/d16231ec0a61e5b0b3c5572493d35c666fe03df3.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/9f78d8341e43fdd6ce22d750ee13b3efaaa8ff57.jpg

Want to share your creation with us? Join us on Discord and remember to leave us a review on Steam, that could boost us alot on the store page! Have fun!

notes.title: New Free Content Update brings you to Nevada
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We released another Free Content Update for Xenon Racer! This update let's you drift through the mountains of Nevada and brings you:

 A new location: Nevada
 New racing team: Helix Wing
 4 new tracks: Nevada Dam, Nevada Grand Canyon, Nevada Route 93 & Nevada Red Rock Canyon

You can check out the trailer right here: https://youtu.be/68OJhqLAD20
The update is out now, so you can immediatly enjoy the new content!

Have fun!

- Danny

notes.title: A new patch just dropped!
notes.content:
Ehi guys, 
a new patch is finally out on Xenon Racer. We are aiming to improve your experience with the game and we fixed some online issues. Now you can start an online lobby by yourself while waiting someone to join it and you can even see lobbies that are already running! So basically now you will be able to unlock everything more easily. We also lowered the difficulty for the career mode, added a new camera, with arcade vibes, and a new shiny achievement!! Keep sending us your feedback and have fun!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705246/baa4e64a66cc93bddff3f8cbee2158a99d034db8.jpg

Full changelog:


 Added Online Voice Chat Volume Option
 Lowered game difficulty in Career mode
 Users are able to view already on-going lobbies online
 All options now are saved as intended
 Graphical improvements on newly added tracks
 Fixed end-race flags on several tracks
 Fixed persisting audio-on-tunnels effect
 Added a new camera
 Added one new unlockable achievement

notes.title: Xenon Racer - Patch notes #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We just published another patch, and this time we're bringing more balancing fixes for difficulty and AI, graphical updates and performance! Here's the full notes:

Gameplay updates

Fixes in AI behaviour. AI will crash less into walls and have less unexpected movements
Fixes in AI difficulty, which result in less unfair situations
Balance fixes between Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty. There should be a more logical elevation in difficulty now
Fixed respawn points on all tracks
Fixed tuning performance on GT LM01 P
Fixed performance of middle wing on GM LM01 P
Fixes in Checkpoint mode, both in edge mode and championship
Fixed problems with binding keys
Fixed problems with binding keys with steering wheels
Removed rear view mirror when racing without any opponents
Fixed problems with unlocking achievements and parts in Time Attack and in multiplayer mode
Added skin for LPN05

Technical updates

Graphical fixes for added performance
Fixed Leaderboard crashes
Fixed some sound and music issues
Fixed a UI error in Championship mode
Fixed invisible wall in Dubai tracks
Fixed Camera problems during the tutorial
Improved performance on Tokyo, Cote d'Azur and Lake Louise tracks

That's it for now, but keep your eyes on here for any future updates! If you haven't yet, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/8C4VYkP

See ya!

-Marten

notes.title: SOEDESCO partners with Monstercat for powerful music in Xenon Racer
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today we're stoked to announce that we're partnering with leading independent EDM record label Monstercat for the music of Xenon Racer!

We feel that the adrenaline-pumping speeds of Xenon Racer are a perfect match with the spirited electro, dubstep, glitch-hop and house music produced by Monstercat's artists.

Xenon Racer features 20 tracks by established artists from the electronic music scene, such as Pegboard Nerds, Rameses B and Melano, as well as Grant, FWLR, Tokyo Machine and Noisestorm.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6917111/44f6ded53a81df1ebf4a5530e9a734580c457de5.jpg

Here's a playlist of all the songs in the game: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLylxjnGTG__WpTCI_-xtCrp4dd3IHwGDB

And here's the full track list:

1.	Bubble Beam by nanobii
